These are unmodified source copies from `de8cc69ef14fae2175b00f7296ef92844c3cacff`.
`source_manifest.json` records their hashes. They are retained for architectural
provenance. Use `pokemon_agent.config`, `pokemon_agent.model` and `pokemon_agent.rl`
for the supported runtime, corrected observation layout, and training commands.
`historical_core.PokeTransformer` is still the base class of the live model.
